Simona Antonescu added a note for Henry Scott about Archery Camp: 6/22-6/26 on Fri, Jun 26 at 9:00am Hi, We hope your child had an amazing time at Battle Camp! It was a pleasure having them with us, and we'd love to continue their archery journey here at Nova. As a Battle Camp participant, you're eligible for a 50% discount on your Nova Membership through September 2 . Simply use coupon code SUMMER2026 when enrolling. Archery Programs Developmental JOAD Thursdays: 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM Saturdays: 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM Sundays: 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM Archery Trio Lessons Available by appointment. If you're not sure which program is the best fit, I'd be happy to help. To enroll or if you have any questions, please contact Simona@novafencingclub.com or call 703-399-5909 . We look forward to welcoming your family back to Nova!
